name: AI Engineer applications v2 - Bayern / Berlin / Amsterdam

assignments.name: showcaseFacts
assignments.value: n8n orchestration, models via OpenRouter (deepseek-v4-flash). Four public job sources: a 55-company Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby board registry, the Bundesagentur v6 API, Arbeitnow and Adzuna. Scans ~494 open engineering roles across Berlin, Bayern and Amsterdam each morning. Two-stage LLM: a cheap scoring pass gates the more expensive generation pass, which cuts token spend several-fold and removes the bias of letting one call both write and grade a letter. Postgres-backed dedupe with fuzzy title matching so one role posted to three boards is one application. The final submit stays manual on purpose: Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby all require the employer's own API key to accept an application, so automating it would mean using credentials I was not issued.

parameters.query:
SELECT dedupe_key, company, status FROM job_applications
WHERE (status IN ('sent', 'queued', 'send_failed')
       AND applied_at > now() - make_interval(days => $1::int))
   OR (status = 'rejected_fit'
       AND applied_at > now() - make_interval(days => $2::int));

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
// All passers at once: Generate Letter then runs the requests concurrently.
return $input.all().map(({ json: j }) => {
  const desc = String(j.description || '');
  const germanish = /(wir suchen|deine aufgaben|ihre aufgaben|abgeschlossenes|kenntnisse|unbefristet|m\/w\/d|bewerbung)/i.test(desc);
  const englishish = /(you will|your profile|we offer|responsibilities|requirements)/i.test(desc);
  const lang = j.country === 'NL' ? 'English' : (germanish && !englishish ? 'German' : 'English');

  // German employers routinely filter on these two being absent before a human reads anything.
  const conventions = (lang === 'German' && cfg.includeSalaryInGerman)
    ? 'Close with a separate final line stating Gehaltsvorstellung: ca. '
      + Number(cfg.salaryExpectationEur).toLocaleString('de-DE') + ' EUR brutto/Jahr, and '
      + 'Eintrittstermin: ' + cfg.earliestStart + ' (Kündigungsfrist: ' + cfg.noticePeriod + ').'
    : 'Do not mention salary expectations.';

  const showcase = cfg.showcaseMode ? [
    'SHOWCASE MODE. The candidate found this role with an agent pipeline he built, and this letter',
    'was drafted by it. Say so plainly and early - in the opening paragraph - and frame it as the',
    'point, not an apology: for an AI-engineering role the system is a working sample of the exact',
    'skill being hired for. Never pretend the letter was hand-written.',
    'Devote the SECOND paragraph to the system, drawn ONLY from SYSTEM FACTS below.',
    'Select the SINGLE fact most relevant to THIS posting and connect it explicitly to a requirement',
    'the ad names. Do not recite the fact list - most of it is irrelevant to any given role.',
    'Example of the reasoning: a posting about retrieval or evaluation -> the two-stage scoring gate;',
    'a posting about data pipelines -> the dedupe and Postgres design; a posting about integrations',
    '-> the four-source normalisation. Pick one, say why it was built that way, name the tradeoff.',
    'Include the honest limitation in substance; it is evidence of real investigation.',
    'Keep the THIRD paragraph on why this specific company and role, using the posting.',
    'Tone: an engineer describing a build, not a pitch. No hype words, no "passionate", no "excited".',
    'Do not claim the system got results it has not got. It is a tool he built, not a proven funnel.',
    cfg.portfolioUrl
      ? 'Reference the write-up at ' + cfg.portfolioUrl + ' once, in the sign-off.'
      : 'Do NOT include any URL, repository link or portfolio link anywhere. None exists. '
        + 'Do not invent one, and do not offer to send one. The LinkedIn profile in the '
        + 'sign-off is the only link.'
  ].join(' ') : '';

  const sys = [
    'You write short, specific job application cover letters.',
    'Return STRICT JSON only:',
    '{"subject":"...","body":"...","talkingPoints":["..."],"linkedinNote":"...","angle":"..."}',
    'Write subject and body in ' + lang + '.',
    'talkingPoints: 2-3 items, each mapping ONE named CV project to ONE requirement the posting',
    'actually states. Format "CV project -> posting requirement". English. No filler.',
    'linkedinNote: a note the candidate will send BY HAND to an engineer or hiring lead at this',
    'company. MAX 300 characters (LinkedIn connection-request limit). Written as a person, not a bot:',
    'one line on the role, one concrete hook from the CV, one short ask. No greeting padding, no',
    'hashtags, no "I hope this finds you well". English unless the posting is German.',
    'angle: one English sentence - the single strongest reason this candidate fits this role.',
    'HARD RULE: never claim experience, tools or years absent from the CV. No invented metrics.',
    cfg.showcaseMode
      ? 'body: 230-320 words, plain text, no markdown. Greeting, three paragraphs, sign-off with name, phone and LinkedIn.'
      : 'body: 180-260 words, plain text, no markdown. Greeting, three short paragraphs, sign-off with name, phone and LinkedIn.',
    cfg.showcaseMode ? showcase : 'Tie 2-3 concrete CV projects to requirements actually named in the posting.',
    'COMPANY-SPECIFIC, MANDATORY: every paragraph must contain something true of THIS company and',
    'THIS posting - the product, the team, the stack, a named requirement. Two letters sent to two',
    'different companies must share no sentence. If the posting is thin on detail, say less rather',
    'than padding with generic praise. Never describe the employer in terms that would fit any',
    'employer ("innovative", "market leader", "exciting projects").',
    conventions,
    'A prior screening step judged the fit; do not restate a score.'
  ].join(' ');

  const usr = ['CV:', cfg.cvText, '',
    'CONTACT: ' + cfg.myName + ', ' + cfg.myPhone + ', ' + cfg.myEmail + ', ' + cfg.myLinkedIn, '',
    'JOB: ' + j.title + ' at ' + j.company + ' (' + j.city + ', ' + j.country + ')',
    'Link: ' + j.url, '',
    'Known gaps to address honestly, not hide: ' + ((j.missing || []).join('; ') || 'none'), '',
    cfg.showcaseMode ? 'SYSTEM FACTS (the ONLY permitted source for claims about the pipeline):' : '',
    cfg.showcaseMode ? cfg.showcaseFacts : '',
    cfg.showcaseMode ? 'This role was surfaced by source: ' + j.source : '', '',
    'Description:', desc.slice(0, 6000) || '(no description available)'].join('\n');

  return { json: { ...j, lang, llmPayload: {
    model: cfg.letterModel,
    messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: usr }],
    max_tokens: 2500,
    temperature: Number(cfg.letterTemperature ?? 0.4),
    reasoning: { effort: cfg.letterEffort || 'low' },
    response_format: { type: 'json_object' } } } };
});

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO job_applications
  (dedupe_key, source, company, title, city, country, region, url,
   contact_email, fit, score_reason, lang, letter, channel, status)
SELECT d.dedupe_key, d.source, d.company, d.title, d.city, d.country, d.region, d.url,
       d.contact_email, d.fit, d.score_reason, d.lang, d.letter, d.channel, d.status
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS d(
  dedupe_key text, source text, company text, title text, city text, country text,
  region text, url text, contact_email text, fit int, score_reason text, lang text,
  letter text, channel text, status text)
WHERE d.dedupe_key IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE
  SET status = EXCLUDED.status, fit = EXCLUDED.fit, score_reason = EXCLUDED.score_reason,
      lang = EXCLUDED.lang, channel = EXCLUDED.channel,
      letter = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.letter, job_applications.letter),
      contact_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_email, job_applications.contact_email),
      applied_at = now();

nodes.notes: Single jsonb parameter - no string interpolation, no injection surface.

parameters.query: SELECT name, ats, token, regions, options FROM employers WHERE active;

INSERT INTO employer_candidates (name, norm_name, regions, sources, ads)
SELECT c.name, c.norm_name, c.regions, c.sources, c.ads
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
  AS c(name text, norm_name text, regions text[], sources text[], ads int)
ON CONFLICT (norm_name) DO UPDATE SET
  last_seen = now(), seen_count = employer_candidates.seen_count + 1,
  ads = GREATEST(employer_candidates.ads, EXCLUDED.ads),
  regions = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(employer_candidates.regions || EXCLUDED.regions)),
  sources = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(employer_candidates.sources || EXCLUDED.sources));
